messages.subject: checkbox and action button
parts:
Hi I wonder if you can help me Im trying to get an action button and checkbox to work in tandem... for instance the user selects the checkbox, clicks on the date range and then selects the action button "go" and this returns the points on the map as expected (as I dont want all points to suddenly appear on the map).  However if the user then clicks for the tracks not to be displayed the points on the map dont disappear until the user presses go.  Ideally Id like the checkbox to remove the points without pressing the go button.  Can anyone offer any advice or help...?

Thanks
